sentences.text: The ACT Integrity Commission considered a parliamentary committee’s corruption complaint about a lease acquisition beside Glebe Park in Canberra City.
sentences.support: the lease of land adjacent to Glebe Park comprising Block 24

sentences.text: It examined the earlier audit and committee reports and the documentary and oral material gathered for them.
sentences.support: detailed examination of the Auditor-General’s Report as well as that of the Committee

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that there was no reasonable basis to suspect corrupt conduct in the acquisition and that further investigation was unjustified.
sentences.support: The evidence does not provide grounds for a reasonable suspicion

notes: No standalone executive summary identified. Existing OPAX findings mean no additional findings quotes. No recommendations list identified.
